name: Missing Universe - Tournament Arc
source:
Welcome to Missing Universe! A Parody Hentai Visual Novel about participating in a tournament against your favorite anime protagonists, with a twist! Each character right before being sent to this tournament are turned into a girl and it is up to them to win in order to regain their titles, bodies, and friends? Experience dark twists in this action packed visual novel like no other!

[From [url=https://lastend.itch.io/missing-universe-tournament-arc]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到失踪的宇宙！一部关于参加与你最喜欢的动漫主角的锦标赛的戏仿无尽视觉小说，而且有所不同！每个角色在被送去参加这次锦标赛之前都变成了一个女孩，他们必须获胜才能重新获得头衔、身体和朋友吗？在这部动作丰富的视觉小说中体验与众不同的黑暗曲折！

[来自[url=https://lastend.itch.io/missing-universe-tournament-arc]Itch.io[/url]]
